cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Assigned by Procedure
cards.instruction: Get someone to accept an unwanted responsibility by proving that the rules, rotation, or tradition make it theirs.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've drawn a box round your Tuesday like yours. Rotation settled. It's your bin night.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I boxed my holiday. I took your Tuesday last week.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Away marked. And I took your Thursday. The swap box says 'one week only.'

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: At your request, so I couldn't keep your easy Thursday. It protects your Tuesday too.
